paper_argument: The Route-A contract system establishes a deterministic, fail-closed pre-board GKP dual-loop execution contract with restricted task-specific simulation evidence; it does not establish V5 LER superiority, NMF lifetime superiority, board-measured break-even, or cross-FPGA SOTA.

evidence_layer_ontology.LITERATURE_ONLY: reported external value without local reproduction

claims.safe_wording_en: Route-A integrates a locked MAP fast path with regime-aware contract/FSM safety and passes preregistered simulator plus one-million-cycle preboard correctness gates.
claims.boundary_zh: 仅限预板系统集成与确定性执行合同，不代表新 V5 性能或真板结果。
claims.upgrade_or_revocation_condition: T6.9.2 board evidence plus stronger full-system performance is required for a full cross-lane paper.

claims.safe_wording_en: On the preregistered smooth matrix, Route-A lowers aggregate paired LER relative to the locked EWMA baseline; periodic drift is the only Holm-confirmed family.
claims.boundary_zh: 只允许报告冻结 smooth matrix 的 aggregate paired 结果；Holm 确认仅 periodic drift。
claims.upgrade_or_revocation_condition: A new frozen method must beat the strongest deployable baselines across preregistered families before global LER wording.
forbidden_wording: advantage over static or Window MAP

claims.safe_wording_en: Static joint MAP has lower average LER than Route-A on the frozen same-model smooth benchmark.
claims.boundary_zh: 必须保留 static joint MAP 更优的反例，不得隐藏或改写为总体优势。
claims.upgrade_or_revocation_condition: Requires a new preregistered same-model experiment with paired improvement CI above zero.

claims.safe_wording_en: For the frozen covariance/prior and complete 10-bit syndrome domain, K4/full static MAP hard actions are identical; resource reductions remain proxies until integrated implementation.
claims.boundary_zh: 仅对冻结 covariance/prior 与完整 10-bit domain 的 hard action 等价成立。
claims.upgrade_or_revocation_condition: Re-enumerate every changed model and integrate K4 into RTL/P&R before hardware promotion.

claims.safe_wording_en: Abrupt/OOD gates establish locked-EWMA safety/non-inferiority under preregistered catastrophic and nominal margins, not broad tail-LER improvement.
claims.boundary_zh: 结论是预注册 margin 下的 safety/non-inferiority，不是广义 tail-LER 改善。
claims.upgrade_or_revocation_condition: Requires preregistered induced-error reduction plus acceptable fallback/false-update costs across abrupt/compound families.

claims.safe_wording_en: Route-A has lower paired LER than the pinned BOCD wrapper on common traces, while that external comparator fails the strict worst-update wall-clock budget; general drift-adaptive SOTA is not established.
claims.boundary_zh: BOCD 的 paired LER 结果必须与其 worst-update 预算失败同时报告。
claims.upgrade_or_revocation_condition: At least two closest external methods must pass identical worst-case compute/wall-clock budgets.

claims.safe_wording_en: Official GQF paper-exact reproduction is blocked by missing/inconsistent source artifacts; no same-GQF lifetime comparison or NMF-surpass claim is available.
claims.boundary_zh: GQF 源码/协议未闭合，不得声称超过 NMF 寿命。
claims.upgrade_or_revocation_condition: All 15 exact gates plus same-GQF matched lifetime LCB must pass; external missing artifacts are not imputed.

claims.safe_wording_en: The no-student Route-A profile preserves the deterministic six-cycle architecture and passes three-seed open-source P&R at 27 MHz; Fmax/resources/power are estimates, not board measurements.
claims.boundary_zh: 六周期、II=1、Fmax/资源均为预板或 post-route estimate。
claims.upgrade_or_revocation_condition: T6.9.2 must provide same-bitstream layered physical measurements.

claims.safe_wording_en: No physical-board correctness, latency, deadline, jitter, resource-readback or power result is currently available.
claims.boundary_zh: 42 个 measured 字段保持 null；不得用 P&R 数值填充。
claims.upgrade_or_revocation_condition: Complete all nine T6.9.2 recovery conditions and rerun the final evidence gate.

claims.safe_wording_en: No FPGA speed advantage is supported because Route-A has no board measurement and the normalized literature table has zero same-task external comparator rows.
claims.boundary_zh: 缺少同任务真板 comparator，不能声称 faster/fastest。
claims.upgrade_or_revocation_condition: Requires T6.9.2 physical measurement and a T6.8.6 same-task comparable subset.
